config.intervention: Train a fresh fusion Transformer from the exact original initialization, masking ch/k in every training and validation forward. Keep all 36 token positions and parameters to preserve phone IDs, initialization and dropout RNG shape. Freeze the acoustic encoder. No fine-tuning from the previously selected Transformer.
config.pairs: Reuse the exact original 64k query/negative-claim schedule, including the random first 4k and CV-only hard negatives thereafter. Do not remine negatives for the subset. Same data, embeddings, order, batch, optimizer, LR and number of updates.
config.selection: Every 500 updates including zero, minimize the equal-weight mean JVS/CV/JTube full-validation normal EER; retain the earliest tie. Same selection rule as the source. Primary: independently selected checkpoint per training condition. Secondary: fixed final 64k checkpoint to remove checkpoint-update differences.
config.comparisons: 36-trained/36-scored, 36-trained/34-scored, and 34-trained/34-scored, each for selected and final checkpoints. The 36-trained/34-scored control keeps the original checkpoint chosen with 36-phone validation; it is not reselected over all old checkpoints for 34 phones. Thus primary differences include training plus checkpoint selection; fixed-final comparisons separate the latter.
config.evaluation: Freeze all old/new selected/final model hashes and every full-validation FAR1% threshold before test inference. Keep the existing five-vowel eligibility gate and original universally-registered masks. Report the three corpora, equal-corpus mean, three acoustic seeds, FAR/FRR, coverage, and JVS cross-text secondary. Prior subset-search discovery/confirmation splits are descriptive only: full validation now selects checkpoints.
config.validation: Before new training, reproduce the original 36-phone 4k prefix for the first acoustic seed and verify all model/optimizer/RNG values and every validation EER. Use an atomic checkpoint containing model, optimizer, RNG, history and best model so restart never mixes checkpoint boundaries.
config.limits: The 34-phone hypothesis was fixed before this run but its test performance was already observed. All test speakers are reused. One Transformer seed and three acoustic seeds, no new population. Bootstrap conditions on fixed checkpoints/subset and excludes training/selection uncertainty. No standard model replacement or additional subset search.

bootstrap.method: Paired query/claim speaker bootstrap, same draws across acoustic seeds and arms; independent corpus draws. Fixed subset/models, excludes selection and training uncertainty.
